how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 17-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Medical Officer post is 17 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Medical Officer posts in ECHS?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Medical Officer position under the Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Medical Officer post must possess an MBBS degree with a minimum of five years of experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Medical Officer position at ECHS?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Medical Officer post will receive a salary of Rs. 95,000 per month, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for ECHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the ECHS Medical Officer recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download, fill, and send the application form to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ECHS Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ECHS Medical Officer recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ECHS Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Officer post includes a Written Test, a Practical Exam, and an Interview to assess candidates' suitability.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for ECHS Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be downloaded from the official website of ECHS, www.echs.gov.in. A direct link is also provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The Medical Officer position at ECHS is an Ad-hoc job type, as specified in the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to apply offline for ECHS Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates typically need to attach self-attested copies of documents such as photographs, signatures, ID proof, and educational certificates with their application form.
